q1.explanationZh: 第二段说弗里基从狮子出生起就照顾它，狮子现在16岁，所以是16年。

evidence.quote: has taken care of a 16-year-old lion since it was born

q2.sampleAnswer: He was born in a zoo.

examples: He was born in a zoo.

q2.explanationZh: 第三段说齐恩的妈妈在动物园生下了它，所以它出生在动物园。

evidence.quote: Zion’s mother was in a zoo when she

q3.sampleAnswer: Because people feared his father would hurt him.

keyPoints.descZh: 人们怕它的父亲会伤害它
examples: Because people feared his father would hurt him.

q3.explanationZh: 第三段说人们担心狮子爸爸会伤害小狮子，所以把它从妈妈身边带走。

evidence.quote: Zion was taken away from his mother because people feared his father would hurt him.

q4.sampleAnswer: He always takes his shoes off.

examples: He always takes his shoes off.

q4.explanationZh: 第五段说散步前弗里基总是脱鞋，因为齐恩不喜欢鞋子的声音。

evidence.quote: Frikkie always takes his shoes off because Zion doesn’t like the noises they make.

q5.sampleAnswer: I want to make friends with parrots. Parrots are very clever. Some of them can learn tricks; some of them can speak a few sentences. If I have a parrot friend, I can teach it some tricks. I may also teach it to talk. We will have a lot of fun together. (Any reasonable answers are acceptable.)

keyPoints.descZh: 说出想交朋友的动物，并给出合理理由
examples: I want to make friends with parrots. Parrots are very clever.

q5.rubricZh: 开放题，言之有理即可：写出动物并给出理由。
q5.explanationZh: 这是开放题：先写你想和哪种动物做朋友，再写原因，比如它聪明、可爱、忠诚。

evidence.quote: But for one animal lover, a lion is his best friend.

q6.explanationZh: laid 后面修饰动作要用副词，gentle 变成 gently（轻轻地）。

q7.explanationZh: a 和 week 之间要形容词，love 变成 lovely（美好的）。

q8.explanationZh: be very … in 要形容词，experienced 是“有经验的”。

q9.explanationZh: the 后面要名词，strong 的名词是 strength（力气）。

q10.explanationZh: was so 后面要形容词，noise 变成 noisy（吵闹的）。

q11.explanationZh: It is said that … 可以改成 … are said to be …，意思不变。

q12.explanationZh: 被动语态是 be + 过去分词，brought up 不能拆，所以是 was brought up。
q12.tipsZh: bring up 的被动：be brought up

q13.explanationZh: 画线部分是 every four hours，问“多久一次”，用 How often。

q14.explanationZh: 前面是否定句 has never hurt，后面反意疑问用肯定的 has he。

q15.explanationZh: 句子意思是“他已经够大，能照顾自己了”。结构是 be old enough to do，take care of himself 是“照顾他自己”。
